post.description: After search_entities, to read the full record and current status of one entity.

business_id.description: The site's internal numeric business id from search_entities (e.g. 820120, 205321, 228610), not the SCC entity id. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Entity detail from the Virginia SCC registry (GET /EntitySearch/BusinessInformation) for the site's internal numeric business_id returned by search_entities: entity name, SCC entity id, entity type, status (with the site's reason for status), series-LLC flag, formation date, status date, VA qualification date, period of duration, industry code, annual report due date, jurisdiction, charter fee, registration fee due date; the registered agent block (type, locality, qualification, name, registered office address); principal office address; the principals table (title, director flag, name, address, last updated) and total shares for stock corporations. The site renders 'N/A' for fields that do not apply; those are null. An unknown business_id is not_found (the site answers an empty page).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `additional_details` | object | Any other label/value pair of the Entity Information section the site renders that is not modelled above, keyed by its label text. |
| `annual_report_due_date` | string | A YYYY-MM-DD date, 'Not Required', or null when N/A. |
| `business_id` | string |  |
| `charter_fee` | string | As displayed, e.g. '$50.00'; null when N/A. |
| `entity_id` | string | Public SCC entity id (e.g. T0608648). |
| `entity_name` | string |  |
| `entity_type` | string |  |
| `formation_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD; null when the site shows N/A (foreign entities). |
| `industry_code` | string | As displayed, e.g. '35 - Insurance Agencies'. |
| `jurisdiction` | string | State or country code as displayed (VA, DE, NY, ...). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `period_of_duration` | string | Perpetual or a date as displayed. |
| `principal_office_address` | string |  |
| `principals` | object[] | The Principal Information table (first page as rendered; stock and nonstock corporations). Empty when the section is absent or has no rows. |
| `registered_agent` | object | Null when the page has no Registered Agent Information section. |
| `registration_fee_due_date` | string | A YYYY-MM-DD date, 'Not Required', or null when N/A. |
| `series_llc` | boolean | Series LLC: Yes/No for limited liability companies; null when N/A. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string | Entity Status as displayed (Active, Inactive, Pending Active, Pending Inactive). |
| `status_date` | string |  |
| `status_reason` | string | 'Reason for Status' as displayed (e.g. Merged, Auto Cancelled); null when N/A or blank. |
| `total_shares` | string | 'Total Shares' of the Current Shares section as displayed; null when the section is absent. |
| `va_qualification_date` | string | Date a foreign entity qualified in Virginia; null for domestic entities. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: To see past and current registered agents of an entity.

business_id.description: The site's internal numeric business id from search_entities. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Registered agent (RA) history of one entity (POST /EntitySearch/BusinessAgentHistory) for the site's internal numeric business_id: appointed date, end date, RA name, registered office address, locality and RA qualification per row, with the entity header (SCC entity id and name). The current agent is on get_entity; this grid read 'No records to view.' for every entity observed so far (an LLC, two foreign corporations and a 1983 domestic corporation, including entities with a filed statement of change of registered agent), so an empty agents array is the common, valid answer and the row shape is modelled on the site's column headers. An unknown business_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `agents` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `appointed_date` | string |  |
| `end_date` | string |  |
| `locality` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `qualification` | string |  |
| `registered_office_address` | string |  |

post.description: To list an entity's filings and their document ids after search_entities or get_entity.

business_id.description: The site's internal numeric business id from search_entities. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

page.description:
1-based page of the filing grid, 10 rows per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 2000; default 1.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Filing history of one entity (POST /EntitySearch/BusinessFilings) for the site's internal numeric business_id: received date, effective date, filing number, microfilm number, document type, status, amendment type, source, page count and, when the site links an image, the document id and the PDF URL (/CommonHelper/DocumentStorageLocalFileget, which needs the consent cookie; the PDF itself is not fetched). The page also carries the entity header, returned as entity_id and entity_name. Pages of 10 rows: page N > 1 is fetched with the grid pager on the same session (verified live to the last page). Page count is null where the site shows N/A (older filings). An unknown business_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `filings` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `amendment_type` | string | Null when the site shows N/A or blank. |
| `document_id` | string | DocumentId of the filing image link; null when the row has no image link. |
| `document_type` | string |  |
| `document_url` | string | https://cis.scc.virginia.gov/CommonHelper/DocumentStorageLocalFileget?DocumentId=...&sourceType=1 (a PDF behind the site's consent cookie); null when the row has no image link. |
| `effective_date` | string |  |
| `filing_number` | string |  |
| `microfilm_number` | string |  |
| `page_count` | number |  |
| `received_date` | string |  |
| `source` | string | In-House, Online, ... as displayed. |
| `status` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Start here to find an entity's business_id and SCC entity id; use get_entity for the full record.

entity_type.description:
Optional entity type filter (the site's Business Type select).

Provider reference: allowed values ["llc", "stock_corporation", "limited_partnership", "general_partnership", "public_service_authority", "business_trust", "nonstock_corporation", "miscellaneous", "protected_series"].

jurisdiction.description:
Optional jurisdiction filter: entities formed in Virginia or foreign entities registered to do business in Virginia.

Provider reference: allowed values ["virginia", "foreign"].

match.description:
The site's name search logic: Starts With (the site's default), Contains or Exact Match. Ignored for entity_id searches.

Provider reference: allowed values ["starts_with", "contains", "exact"]; default "starts_with".

page.description:
1-based results page, 25 rows per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 2000; default 1.

query.description: Entity name text (search_type entity_name) or an SCC entity id such as T0608648, F1725607 or 11035161 (search_type entity_id).

search_type.description:
Which field the site searches: the entity name (SearchType=businessname) or the SCC entity id (SearchType=businessid).

Provider reference: allowed values ["entity_name", "entity_id"]; default "entity_name".

status.description:
Optional status filter (the site's Business Status select).

Provider reference: allowed values ["pending_active", "active", "inactive", "pending_inactive"].

200.description:
Search the Virginia SCC business entity registry (POST /EntitySearch/Index) by entity name (Starts With, Contains or Exact Match) or by SCC entity id, optionally filtered by entity type, status and jurisdiction (Virginia or foreign). Returns the results grid as displayed: SCC entity_id, entity name, name type (Legal Name or Fictitious Name), entity type, series-LLC flag, principal office address, registered agent name, status, plus the site's internal numeric business_id that get_entity, get_entity_filings, get_entity_agent_history and get_entity_name_history take. 25 rows per page; the site's pager is session-bound, so page N re-runs the search and asks the pager for page N on the same session. A search with no match is a valid empty result (the site's 'No records found with your search criteria.'), not an error. One entity id can return many rows (one per legal and fictitious name).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `business_id` | string | The site's internal numeric id (from the row's SeriesLLC(id, ...) link), the key for get_entity, get_entity_filings, get_entity_agent_history and get_entity_name_history. |
| `entity_id` | string | Public SCC entity id as displayed (e.g. T0608648, F1725607, 11035161). |
| `entity_name` | string |  |
| `entity_type` | string | Entity type as displayed (Limited Liability Company, Stock Corporation, Nonstock Corporation, ...). |
| `name_type` | string | Legal Name, Fictitious Name, ... as displayed. |
| `principal_office_address` | string | One-line address as displayed; null when blank. |
| `registered_agent_name` | string | 'RA Name' column; null when blank. |
| `series_llc` | boolean | The 'Series LLC' column: true/false for limited liability companies, null when the site leaves it blank (other entity types). |
| `source_url` | string | The entity detail page for this row. |
| `status` | string | Status as displayed (Active, Inactive, Pending Active, Pending Inactive). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
